notes.title: [0.7.0] Android Version is Coming!
notes.content:
Android version preview 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/7a927e6af92d805f97ae614f2bec02ed12af4cf2.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/927d26cedad05feca87bfffdacf44cf3add5fa85.jpg
I didn't originally plan to make an Android version because the fragmentation and permission changes on the Android end are really tricky, and people may not need a desktop application that consumes more power than games. But one day, a sentence suddenly came to my mind: Since we've all run here, why don't we keep going?

So after more than a month of testing, the various functions of the Android end were ported. Fortunately, the data architecture did not need to be modified, and there were no major issues with the interaction. In theory, the configuration files of different clients can be shared, making it convenient for users to modify the scene on the PC and import it to the Android version with just one click. In addition to the default touchscreen input, Android also supports external keyboard, mouse, and controller modes, making it convenient for mobile and tablet users to use.

The remaining work is to list various app stores, dealing with various listing rules and different terminal systems is the most difficult part!  Please be patient, and I will notify everyone as soon as the Android version is released! 


 Update Content 
This update mainly aims to improve the support of various input devices for advanced program functions (such as entering editing mode, operating UI, key rebinding, etc.), ensuring that users using different devices can have a complete experience as much as possible.

 Keyboard and Mouse Mode: Change the default grab key to the G key and the default trigger key to the left mouse button.
 Controller mode: When a clickable UI appears on the screen, move the virtual cursor through DPad to simulate mouse clicking, dragging, and other operations.
 VR mode: Now supports opening menus through the menu key or the X key on the left joystick, allowing for editing mode, browser opening, and other operations.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/c4777ba0f3c422aec389969c23123dd93d6ff60c.jpg
 New: The settings interface has added a "Input Settings..." module, which allows customization of key bindings for some input devices
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/070acad7f84567ce39cba2d3feb383098d02da57.jpg
 Optimization: Normal mode, using a circular UI highlight to indicate that the current pointing object is interactive, and displaying the currently activated transformation mode on both sides of the UI during grabbing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/b0983dc93da6cc06ab4088bfe0361f7ca9a7b1b1.jpg

notes.content:
Main update content

Supports loading multiple external model Mods. Just right-click to open the browser, switch the "Type" on the left to "Model", and then you can view all available Model Mods. After downloading, on the "Downloaded" page, find the corresponding model Mod and click the checkbox in the upper left corner to load/unload:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/d8248a6433a50772d4dd3132828d95e53669dcd4.jpg
If the source object is lost, a purple question mark square will be used instead (which can be selected and deleted in Edit mode):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/036a7386b046c3797b67e7aa3ddfe2c837da5e14.jpg
Add a new user status bar in the bottom right corner (airplane mode, attachment mode, etc.), which will only be temporarily displayed when the mouse moves to this area:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/4b42cea063befd2ffaf804d9bf6db5d2106b6b72.jpg
Change the Mod file name to a unique ID for easy loading of multiple files simultaneously.


New model Mod
This update has added the first model Mod Toy Car. The car doors and tailgate can be opened and closed. Right click on them and select "Drive/Cancel Drive" to switch driving mode, or right click on them and select "Attach to this object..." to drive in first person. Note that the character cannot move while driving (as input data needs to be transmitted to the vehicle).
This vehicle can be configured with power distribution for four wheels (relevant configurations can be found in the CarController component, where listWheelInfo stores configuration information for the four wheels):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/b013c27bf5ba76a4e5d529edd6cf0e0814cb23fa.png
Base on the default parameters, the following effects can be achieved by modifying some properties:

Crab Walk: The steelScale of the four wheels is set to 1 (all four wheels rotate in the same direction)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/ec5a07f22da9a8290a4a51252a67f3c65606b9f0.gif
Drift: motorForce set to 20 (to increase power), sidewaysFriction/stiffness of the last two wheels set to 0.5 (to reduce rear wheel grip)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/4273daa69d0ff287a301191bc5d70eb021f90b19.gif
Tank Turn: motorForce set to 20, maxSteerAngle set to 90, and SteerScale set to -1 for the last two wheels (rear wheel reverse)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/21f7b214f3484823629d737625d7eaa45bc3f8b0.gif


Development Log
Finally, the loading and management of the model Mod have been completed, and there will be a qualitative improvement in the update iteration of Mod in the future! The function, which was originally thought to be very complex and had been entangled for 2 years, was actually completed within 1 month. It seems that the biggest enemies are laziness and fear!

notes.title: [0.3.0]Support workshops! Provide more interesting indoor interactable objects!
notes.content:
First of all, congratulations to everyone in advance for a happy new yearːsteamhappyː
This update has extracted a large number of common modules, and once the packaging process is tested, the SDK will be provided to upload Mods to everyone!

 Main update content 

 Formal support for creative workshops! Subsequent new themes will be uniformly updated through creative workshops, and the original Ocean scene has now been migrated to Workshop, simply right-click on the browser page in the program and subscribe to download.
 Add built-in default scene [Default]! In this spacious scene, the following built-in decorative objects can be tested.


 Built-in decorative objects 
This update adds a large number of built-in decorative objects, making it convenient for future users to reuse in different Mod scenes. Simply enter the editing mode through the right-click menu, right-click and select "Add Decoration" to add them to the scene. Most objects can be dragged and their properties can be modified, and their state will be saved. Some special objects are introduced as follows:

 Pegboard: can be placed on any plane, unaffected by gravity, and can attach interactive objects to the surface of this object. It is possible to modify its material properties.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/57f46edd2130425c3dbab43b86e9c258a20c4f6d.gif
 Clock: Display system time. You can modify its pointer animation, time displacement (used to simulate different time zones), and other properties.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/1cdf25e0f8129fb74a8c009d1c3f518dbd843320.gif
 Lamp: Provide real-time lighting, which can be turned on and off by using activate key (For example: G key in PC mode). You can modify the brightness, color, and shadow casting range of its lights.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/c72a7c4819d677d3fbf0dac99235dc1861b74145.gif
 Office Chair: The upper body can be dragged and rotated. Players can sit on the chair (right-click on it and select "Attach to this object" (don't spin yourself out!).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/a1ebdd0110873b13ed607fbcfb215a8363003f9c.gif
 Desk: Contains 3 drawers that can be opened and stored for objects.
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/cf7a13517c68e1e668b7786762be021c0fa167d5.gif
Laptop: The top cover can be dragged and opened. The material of its A/B/C/D surface can be modified. The display content of its screen can be changed, supporting files in the following formats from local or network sources: static images (jpg, png), dynamic images (gif), videos (mp4)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/0c653af08979f534ae304fa2d9edf451a4cf7194.gif


 Optimization 

Changing the rendering mode from Deferred to Forward+can support as many real-time lights as possible while optimizing performance.
When adding a new object, it will first display its position information by creating a temporary object, and use a virtual axis to display its orientation. Users can rotate the scroll wheel to make it turn.

New Feature:
- Players can attach to specific objects such as boats and ducks, making it easier to drive or roller coaster later on. To attach, right-click on the object and select "Attach to this object"; To cancel the attachment, right-click on the blank space and select "Cancel Attachment". If the character's orientation is abnormal due to attachment, right-click on the blank space and select "Reset Position".

Optimization:
- Press Esc to exit the top-level UI
- [PC Mode] Increase the current mouse interaction highlight prompt information.

Fix:
- Due to delayed restoration sequence, the restored objects are misplaced.

Coming next:
- I am currently testing the SDK and packaging, and it is expected that the next version will start acive the  Workshop!

notes.title: [0.2.0] Support VR mode!
notes.content:
Content

The underlying framework has been changed to OpenXR+XRI in order to use mature interaction and input systems, and also to pave the way for compatibility with a wide range of XR devices in the future. (Although this switch of work took a lot of time, it was all worth it! Because it was really fun!)
In Normal mode, the interactive models in the scene can not only be dragged with the mouse/vr controller, but also be attached to specific models (such as ducks and boats). By the way, did I mention that the sun is also an interactive object?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/4c8b8c0006302b3d1350e1c313dd6cba9a8e493a.gif
Added VR mode, now you can use your device that supports OpenXR to experience 3D desktop!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/7c9e5088bb6c244e6e6b37c3ad07da78b0a01dc7.gif
Edit mode Add the function of modifying model parameters. Now you can select the file system model in the scene and modify its name and preview image in the Inspector window;
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/3b62ad5554433e7bf2a8c0d6b560343a8c40961d.png
Edit mode Add the function of modifying scene parameters. After switching to the Config window, you can modify the Mod or global configuration (as shown in the following figure). Try using PostProcessing to create an underworld effect!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44561819/5105b752fe7a481fd5d6b0c4e4a9b345a7b583a6.png


Note

Currently, the VR mode does not support editing systems, and we hope to improve it.
Please refer to the internal help document of the program for the operation method of PC/VR mode (right-click in the blank space - Help).
If the program is intercepted by antivirus software errors and cannot be initialized, an error message and solution will pop up.
